summary: Implementation plan for UrbanTwin (ProphetProp engine) featuring Street View photo-to-3D block reconstruction, animated 3D low-poly pedestrians walking and queuing, deterministic ProphetProp simulator for 1-day/30-day/365-day horizons, live Google Maps and Seoul presets (Seongsu & Mangwon), and real-time Gemini-powered what-if scenario testing.
